recordType: Observed GitHub Actions results; passing regression checks do not establish automatic victory or complete game correctness
implemented: Separate automatic skill/ultimate presentation from manual movement ownership in the native frame predicate. Preserve real input, manual grace, buffered actions, hurt, guard, dash and native movement locks.
Do not classify an autoAwakeningV31336 navigation target as a user pointer target.
Replace the seven-second off-portal interaction bypass with proximity-checked native interaction.

When an eligible automatic exit path is stalled, release only auto-owned target/path for ordinary replanning; do not move the actor, mark objectives complete, or bypass the native transition/save gates.
Retain RC121 laser connectivity, removed escape bands, owner-specific artwork, ricochet fixes, and death-dialog behavior. No damage, HP, attack cooldown, or difficulty tuning was applied.

baseline.observation: In the original desktop first battle, full-auto was enabled but early samples remained at x=16,y=16 with manual-commit/disabled role state while automatic skill presentation was active.
baseline.comparisonLimit: The baseline observed about 45 seconds per viewport and the extended candidate desktop case observed 180 seconds. Damage totals, death-dialog sample counts and runtime are not matched statistical before/after measurements. No percentage reduction in deaths or damage is claimed.

extendedNaturalDesktopDream.interpretation: Automatic locomotion and steering during casts were observed. Repeated deaths and first-boss failure remained. This passing test validates locomotion and absence of runtime deadlock, not PC Dream victory.

existingNaturalDreamCases.interpretation: The first boss was no longer present and no live enemies remained in the final sample; the observation ended before next-map entry was demonstrated. Do not reuse RC121 next-map success as an RC122 observation.

testContractChange: RC115's old far-exit bypass expectation was deliberately replaced with proximity and no-teleport assertions. Combat/objective/pause/ownership guards remain tested. The change is not a claim that all maps have now been traversed.
cleanup: One-off source inspection writers and bulky source copies were removed from the final tree. RC122 regression is workflow_dispatch-only with contents:read and no automatic gameplay patch/commit. Historical data remain in the baseline run and branch history.
remaining: PC Dream repeated deaths and reliable full-auto first-boss clear remain unresolved despite repaired locomotion ownership.
RC122 mobile Dream next-map progression was not demonstrated within the 101-second observation window.
No new time-dependent laser escape trajectory planner was implemented; existing native hazard evaluation remains.
Portal artwork has not been replaced with authored doors/stairs. Exit approach/repath is a prerequisite, not the visual replacement itself.
Full campaign/endings, every map transition, all heroes/directions, image loading/memory, attack phase animation and physical-device mobile performance remain unverified or pending.
Screenshots were generated by real remote Chromium and existing automated visual comparisons passed; PNGs were not manually opened in this session.
